title: SQL source-to-target reconciliation with precision and row-integrity checks

sql.baseline_query: SELECT transaction_id, amount, status, event_time FROM source_transactions ORDER BY transaction_id

candidate_queries.good: SELECT transaction_id, amount, status, event_time FROM target_transactions_good ORDER BY transaction_id
candidate_queries.regression: SELECT transaction_id, amount, status, event_time FROM target_transactions_regression ORDER BY transaction_id

validation_plan.objective: Validate SQL source-to-target reconciliation, representation fidelity, schema compatibility and row completeness before release.

scenarios.name: schema_compatibility
scenarios.assertion: baseline and candidate queries must expose the required key and critical columns
scenarios.expected: all required SQL columns are present with no missing baseline fields

scenarios.name: row_reconciliation
scenarios.assertion: candidate rows must reconcile one-to-one against baseline rows by transaction_id
scenarios.expected: no missing, extra or duplicate-key records are observed

scenarios.name: precision_and_value_fidelity
scenarios.assertion: critical SQL values must preserve exact expected representation and content
scenarios.expected: amount, status and event_time exactly match the baseline for every transaction_id
